argv: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'python(.exe)?"? -m agentos_node.client_cli run'} | Select-Object ProcessId,CreationDate,CommandLine; $ff=(Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); [pscustomobject]@{process=$p;ffmpeg=if($ff){$ff.Source}else{$null}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
